description: SHARED retrieval config, read by BOTH news engines. `wave_keywords` drives the historical GKG replay (matched against article URL + page title) AND the live/forward Anthropic web_search pull (src/cli.py's pull-news turns each wave's terms into queries via retriever.WebSearchRetriever). Edit the terms here and both paths change; the backtest additionally needs a RE-INGEST, because the keyword regex is what BigQuery is queried with. The `engine` block is GKG-only (ontopic_offset, max_scan_gb, a BigQuery cost guard). Iterate HERE; no code change. `wave_keywords` are matched case-insensitively (a space allows a hyphen, for URL slugs) against each article's URL and page title; NO company/ticker names - the curator discovers the tickers. `org_stoplist` is substring-matched to drop non-company ENTITIES (engine mechanics). The SOURCE lists (source_block / source_major, domain substrings) now live in news_sources.md as the single source of truth - gkg_pool reads them from there.
_wave_maintenance_note: WHEN THE USER ADDS A WAVE (or subwave) TO investor_profile.md: naming it in the profile does NOT feed retrieval by itself. NEITHER path auto-adapts -- you MUST add matching wave_keywords below, which the live web_search pull picks up on its next run, and the BACKTEST additionally needs a RE-INGEST: you MUST add matching wave_keywords below, then RE-INGEST (the keyword regex changes, so BigQuery is re-queried) + re-rank + re-curate. Formerly-uncovered subwaves NOW COVERED (2026-07-24, reversing the 2026-07-21 document-don't-fix choice): the geopolitical 'energy/tankers' subwave (oil/crude/product tanker, tanker rates/demand, vlcc, strait of hormuz) and the 'Middle East reconstruction' subwave (gaza/syria/lebanon/iran/middle east reconstruction, reconstruction contract, vision 2030, megaproject, engineering and construction). Takes effect on the next GKG re-ingest. (The aging_demographics wave was ADDED 2026-07-21 and BROADENED 2026-07-24 from 4 senior-housing-REIT-only keywords - two of which, 'senior living reit' and 'senior housing operator', matched 0 corpus articles - to 28 aging-economy terms, then TRIMMED 2026-07-24 to 16 high-precision terms - dropped the low-precision/human-interest terms (senior care, anti-aging, home health, hospice, healthy aging, aging in place, caregiving, mobility aid, aging population) plus redundant substrings (elder care, longevity economy) that add noise without investable signal; takes effect on the next GKG re-ingest.)
